text:
Sophie: @channel incident-bot paged on dedicated pool 'sentinel-pool' node sentinel-node-17 — GPU0 ECC parity errors -> emergency reset. Metrics: token latency spike +10x for SentinelCorp (VPC-dedicated). Automated drain kicked. Please ack.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2468: severity=high, affected_tenant=sentinel-corp, pool=sentinel-pool, node=sentinel-node-17
James: taking this. seeing repeated AER/PCIe errors in syslog. starting controlled evacuation of tenants, will route surviving requests to reserved fallback pool and enable per-tenant isolation for sentinel-corp.
Amelia: on call handoff in 20m if you need. keep me in the loop.
James: running drain command now to start live migration of long-lived KV caches and to flush KV prefix caches for active sessions.
James: ```bash
# drain node, exclude maintenance tenants
redwoodctl drain-node --pool sentinel-pool --node sentinel-node-17 --mode graceful --timeout 600
```
James: immediate logs: 
[00:01:12] gpu0: AER: uncorrectable error, resetting GPU
[00:01:13] kube-sched: evicting pod redwood-worker-sentinel-0 (tenant=sentinel-corp)
[00:02:05] traffic-router: fallback to reserved-pool-1 for tenant sentinel-corp
Sophie: Account-ENG can you prepare customer status note? Need to confirm if any SLAs will be impacted and whether they'd like us to failover to hosted API during the repair window.
Account-ENG: drafting note. quick question — do we have any long-running fine-tune or batch jobs from SentinelCorp on that node?
James: checked job-scheduler, nothing active from sentinel-corp beyond interactive calls. No training jobs. main risk is request latency for live API traffic during cache reload.
Customer-POC: we see increased 5xx from our side, but not widespread — some queries time out. We're ok with brief failover if you recommend. Please confirm ETA for full node replace.
Amelia: quick triage summary: node is spot-backed host (mixed-capacity pool) — looks like host-level eviction + thermal + ECC combos. Suggest: 1) quarantine node, 2) migrate tenants to reserved fallback and burst pools, 3) reprovision replacement on non-spot capacity, 4) run NVLink and memory health checks before rejoining pool.
Infra-SRE: concur. I'm spinning up a non-spot replacement node in same AZ (reduces cross-AZ latency). Also capturing dmesg + BMC logs for hardware ticket to provider.
James: tenant isolation step executed — sentinel-corp pinned to reserved-pool-1 and traffic split 90/10 to warm-fallback while we validate caches. No data plane leak observed.
incident-bot: PAGE UPDATED INC-2468: status=mitigating, lead=James, handoff_due=20m
Sophie: heads-up: can we run a lightweight eval on sentinel-corp's incoming prompt set to verify quality after model migration? Redwood-Optimize flagged some quantization differences with fallback model variant.
James: running canary against 100 recent prompts now. Will post results.
James: canary results: 100 prompts -> 98/100 match in top-3 responses, latency median from 110ms -> 160ms on fallback. No major regression.
Account-ENG: user-facing note ready to send (sent to Customer-POC for approval): "We've isolated a GPU hardware fault in your dedicated pool and migrated your traffic to a verified fallback pool. You may see slightly higher latency (~50ms) for ~30–45 minutes while caches warm. No model output changes expected. We're replacing the affected host and will notify when fully restored."
Customer-POC: please send. we appreciate the quick mitigation. keep us posted on ETA.
Infra-SRE: replacement node provisioned (non-spot) and undergoing health checks: nvlink_test OK, memtest small-run OK, driver probe OK. ETA to join pool: ~18 minutes.
Amelia: I'll take the on-call handoff in 12m and follow the replacement join. James — can you document steps for postmortem? include logs, BMC dump, job history, drain timing, tenant migration events, and account comms thread.
James: will do. immediate next steps: 1) finish replacement join, 2) monitor sentinel-corp error rate and latency for 60m, 3) if stable, re-enable spot policy on pool or keep non-spot? recommend keep non-spot to avoid recurrence for this customer's SLA.
Sophie: Account-ENG to propose non-spot reservation offer to SentinelCorp for long-term stability; include cost delta.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE INC-2468: resolved -> node removed from pool and replacement joined. Please run post-incident review form: https://redwood.internal/incident/inc-2468/review
Customer-POC: confirmed no further 5xx and performance back to normal. thanks team.
Amelia: handing off long-tail monitoring to infra-sre for 4h. James — assign postmortem owner when you create the doc.
James: postmortem draft started and assigned to me. initial timeline and mitigation steps captured. i'll attach logs and final customer note.
Sophie: thanks all. action items: [Account-ENG] propose non-spot offer, [Infra-SRE] attach BMC + dmesg to hardware ticket, [James] finish postmortem and include regression checklist for fallback models. Closing thread once postmortem link is in PR. :white_check_mark:
